mentions.name: Brewdio
mentions.description: Open source homebrewing (beer) software built on core Rust libraries with a web app and a terminal UI, plus an Android app in development. It is designed to be offline-first using a CRDT persistence layer with an optional sync server, and is adding "bring your own AI" assistant integration to help tweak recipes and make suggestions.
